_comment: Provider + corpus config for THIS deployment (Unity 6.x offline docs, Manual/ + ScriptReference/). Provider block = C:/dev/ds_flash.json (venus proxy, deepseek-v4.1-flash-official) with thinking_effort lowered from 'high' to 'low'. Corpus/engine settings mirror config.json. Usage: uv run python -m rag compile --config ds_flash_low.json [--steps corpus,index] [--dry-run]. ONE quota pool = (host, api_key): never pass this file twice (or alongside another venus config with the same key) as 'two providers'. Per-provider concurrency > 4 triggers 429.
